newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: Zimbabwe rape cases rising steadily.
newsitem.headline: Zimbabwe rape cases rising steadily.

text.p: Rape cases in Zimbabwe have risen steadily in the last five years, with over 50 percent of the victims being children under 16, a police officer said on Monday.
Deputy police commissioner Godwin Matanga told a police training seminar that some 3,212 rape cases were reported last year, 3,148 in 1995, 2,610 in 1994 and 2,315 in 1993.
He urged police officers to encourage the public to report rape cases, saying because of the stigma attached to the crime, many cases went unreported and real incidence could be higher.

"This is further compounded by some members of our society, regretably including churches, who in a way encourage such satanic acts by dissauding the bringing of such cases to the attention of the authorities," he said.
